diagnosis_kind: bounded-local (harvest + podman repro; no cloud window, $0 spend)

verdict.task_provability: provable — the member's H-allow cell CAN produce reward-1 under the declared constraints; the oracle trajectory completes in ~121 s vs the task_toml 900 s agent deadline
verdict.summary: The agent_timeout x6 signature is produced by the shared w1 cell-exec capture path, not by the h_allow egress leg and not by task difficulty. exec_guarded (crates/hh-runner/src/cell.rs) pipes the exec'd process's stdout and stderr but never drains them until after the child exits; when the oracle solve.sh's output crosses the effective pipe capacity (~64 KiB OS pipe +/- podman/conmon slack), the in-cell writer blocks (in-cell freeze) or the exec never returns after in-cell completion (return hang); the in-cell timeout ladder then lapses the exec at 900 s and kill-on-lapse (HH_EXEC_TAG sweep) produces agent_timeout. pypi-server froze mid-script (before Step 2.5's pip) so the pypi-server/upload work never landed -> reward 0; make-doom-for-mips shows the identical signature with completed work -> agent_timeout + reward 1.
verdict.mediator_verdict: fully exonerated — identical agent_timeout x3 on the H-pub surface which carries zero mediated tunnels; every H-allow request decided allow, eof-only closes, decide latency p50 7-8 ms / max 108 ms

mechanism.defect_site: crates/hh-runner/src/cell.rs exec_guarded (podman exec child spawned with Stdio::piped() on stdout and stderr; read_to_end called only after try_wait observes exit — neither stream is drained while the child runs)
mechanism.secondary_site: agent exec captured stdout/stderr are kept in CellOutcome on lapse but dropped by run_cell — the H-cell agent transcript is never persisted to the cell dir (observability gap; the freeze position is inferred from the oracle transcript + WAL, not byte-confirmed)
failure_modes: in-cell write-block: the container-side writer blocks once cumulative unread output crosses the effective bound (~64 KiB pipe + conmon/socket slack) — zero forward progress, zero egress attempts, until the 900 s in-cell timeout ladder kills the tagged tree

exec return-hang: the in-cell script completes but podman exec cannot finish delivering captured output to the full host-side pipe, so the exec never exits — try_wait never fires -> same 900 s lapse -> agent_timeout even though all work completed
mechanism.why_pypi_reward_0: the freeze lands at ~60.4-60.6 KB of transcript — inside the window between the venv pip install's last egress (t~80 s) and Step 2.5's first index fetch (python3 -m pip install build twine) — so Steps 2.5-6 (twine install, htpasswd, pypi-server start, vectorops build+upload) never ran; the verify then finds no local index -> decided reward 0
mechanism.why_doom_reward_1: make-doom-for-mips emits ~67.7 KB; its needed artifacts (linked doomgeneric_mips) exist before/at the bound -> work complete -> verify passes -> decided reward 1 despite the same agent_timeout
mechanism.effective_bound_note: the per-cell byte bound is not fixed in the evidence: pypi-server's freeze at ~60.5 KB transcript and doom's completion through ~66 KB imply the bound varies with conmon/socket buffering and per-run transcript size (clang warnings on stderr count separately); bounded bracket ~60-78+ KB. The class-level mechanism is code-proven; the per-cell constant is not byte-exact from harvest alone.

repair_candidates: exec_guarded: drain stdout and stderr concurrently while the child runs (reader threads or poll+read into a bounded spool) — removes both failure modes for every cell, both H surfaces
alternative: redirect the in-cell phase output to a file and copy-out at end of phase (exec streams become non-blocking)
observability: persist the agent exec's captured streams to the cell dir on lapse (the bytes are already kept in CellOutcome; run_cell drops them) — would have made this byte-exact
scope_decision_input: the discordance is reparable machinery on the shared exec path — the `machinery{h_allow}` cell fold was correct to flag machinery, but the repair target is exec_guarded's stream handling (H-pub + H-allow both), NOT the hardened egress leg which the evidence fully exonerates; a machinery repair in the chain is viable and small; a bounded smoke leg re-running pypi-server + make-doom-for-mips after the drain fix would verify the repair against the recorded signature
